notes.summary: Folio 72 continues an induction discussion, states C7₀, gives a parenthetical nonconverse, and proposes a later canonical strengthening. The complete lower draft and its diagram are cancelled. All three supplied images and seventeen own crops were inspected individually. Every target is fully framed; no missing continuation was found.
notes.math_reading_decisions: No theorem was proved or independently checked. The contrast between the two order signs prompted close inspection, but decisions use their ink. The quantified earlier G′ does not settle the final C′/G′. No mathematical expectation changed a letter or implication direction.
notes.author_checks: Local changes visible on the sheet: earlier capitals under G/F, cancelled peut, a separately scribbled heading, inserted Considérons les with a drawn leader, cancelled équivalentes, three broad diagonal strokes and an additional strike through the C6 proof line. The small marks at rôle, faux and before C7 are preserved graphically without inventing complete deleted characters.
notes.title_dates_pagination: Handwritten folio 72; scan marker 73 retained. No date or additional cote marker. The lower title remains uncertain.
notes.scope: Only the assigned packet, brief, notation snapshot and R1 output were used. The supplied C_context cross-page audit tail, encountered during its initial full read, was disregarded as instructed by the parent. No other page or reader was accessed.
notes.collation_conventions: Difference rows separate lexical readings, placement, underlining, broad deletion state and drawing geometry. marked_in_h=yes identifies an unreadable/doubt marker or an explicit editorial uncertainty/deletion note, not ordinary emphasis. Equivalent preceq/preccurlyeq encodings are not counted. Named figure references identify the complete TikZ in reading.tex.
